notes: SCM registration or running state alone is not treated as proof of a loaded kernel image.
Unavailable or partial PSAPI enumeration cannot prove that an unmatched driver is unloaded.
Catalog lookup covers registered local SHA256/SHA1 memberships, not every possible publisher package.
Generic Authenticode/catalog trust checks do not establish kernel-signing policy acceptance or publisher VM support.
No observed driver at a sampled installer stage does not prove that the publisher has no ARM64 driver.
Raw event messages are omitted; visible official installer dialogs require separate redacted capture.
File hashes identify on-disk candidates; loaded-image bytes are not read or dumped. Identity confirmation is limited to documented loaded-image path correlation.
